subject: Helios platform: latency & error spike since model rollout — readout + stakeholder asks
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@helioshealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@helioshealth.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 23:12:00 -0700
Subject: High latency + error spikes after 8/19 model rollout

Hi Lauren / Marissa —

We rolled the new ranking model to production at ~17:40 UTC on 2026-08-19 and immediately started to see 95th percentile tail latency climb from ~420ms to 2.1s and a corresponding increase in 5xx errors across our API (error rate peaked ~3.6%). This is impacting our patient-facing search and triage flows.

I attached a short extract of the error log and our kubernetes pod restart counts (helios_error_log_0819.txt). Our oncall has temporarily rate-limited requests to reduce customer impact, but this is causing timeouts for critical workflows.

Urgent asks:
- Can Redwood confirm whether there was a serving-side change tied to the model variant we pushed?
- If a rollback is available, can we schedule that immediately?
- We need an ETA on mitigation and a public-facing incident timeline we can share internally.

Available for a call now or in 30m — Ops is standing by.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Platform, Helios Health
(sarah.jenkins@helioshealth.com)

Attachment: helios_error_log_0819.txt (text, 48KB)

Marissa will run the external comms; Karthik, can your team confirm whether the rollout triggered any new kernel/quantization config on the serving fleet for Helios? If rollback is the fastest mitigation we should do it immediately.

Immediate plan (proposed):
- Karthik: triage and confirm rollback viability + timeline (owner)
- Marissa: customer comms and coordinating the conference bridge (owner)
- Neha: commercial lead — prepare a proposed credit/SLR message for the account
- Rishi: exec escalation and decision rights if rollback impacts other accounts

We are initiating a 15-minute triage call at 10:30 PDT — join link in Drive doc (see related_links). I will own the post-call readout to Helios execs.

Please reply with explicit confirmations.

— Lauren

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, sarah.jenkins@helioshealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 02:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency + error spikes after 8/19 model rollout

Lauren / team — quick technical readout:

What we see so far:
- The model variant rolled for Helios included an updated attention kernel that increases memory work per token by ~1.6x for long contexts. Median latency is OK, but tails spike when requests hit sequence lengths >1024.
- KV cache hotpaths show higher memory pressure; GC and eviction cycles correlate with the 5xx bursts.

Immediate mitigations attempted (status):
- Scoped traffic-shift to older variant (v2.3) on 2 dedicated nodes — reduced error rate to ~0.9% in canary (in progress).
- Throttle heuristics applied at edge to cap per-user concurrency — reduced tail latency but impacted throughput (live).

Rollback viability:
- Rolling back to v2.3 globally is low-risk and we can target a full rollback within 30 minutes once we get customer approval. Rollback checklist attached (rollback-checklist.pdf).

Trace artifacts: we uploaded serving traces and kernel profiles to the incident folder. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/helios-incident-0820
Attachment: serving-traces-0820.tar.gz (contains perf traces)

If Helios approves rollback, we should communicate expected impact window (~15–30 minutes for progressive rollback, brief capacity throttling during change).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency + error spikes after 8/19 model rollout

Hi Sarah —

We appreciate the quick heads-up and are sorry for the impact to Helios workflows. Per Karthik's analysis, we have a low-risk rollback path to the previous model variant (v2.3) that we can execute with your go-ahead.

Proposed immediate steps (timeline):
- 10:40 PDT: brief triage call (15m) to authorize rollback and confirm runbook steps
- 10:45 PDT: begin progressive rollback (15–30m)
- 11:15 PDT: post-rollback verification and re-open production traffic

Customer visible changes: brief reduction in throughput for ~10–20 minutes during the switch, then expected return to pre-rollout latency.

Would you like us to proceed with rollback now? If yes, please reply here with approval and we’ll start the run.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: High latency + error spikes after 8/19 model rollout — exec readout

Folks — quick executive summary for the Helios leadership thread and Redwood leadership: several points for awareness and follow-up.

What happened: the 8/19 model variant introduced a heavier attention kernel that increases memory pressure for long sequences; that drove eviction/GC cycles and intermittent 5xx errors at the Helios scale.

What we did:
- Scoped canary to older variant and applied throttles to limit tail amplification (10:05–10:25 PDT).
- With Helios approval, executed progressive rollback to v2.3 (10:45–11:05 PDT).
- Post-rollback verification shows 95th percentile latency returned to baseline (~430ms) and error rate <0.5%.

Customer impact & remediation:
- Helios experienced ~45 minutes of degraded experience; Ops performed customer-facing rate limiting which affected throughput for critical flows.
- Offer: 10% invoice credit for the impacted hour and a joint post-mortem in 48 hours. Neha, please draft the credit language and commercial note.

Follow-ups (owners):
- Karthik: full perf post-mortem (INF-4823) + mitigation plan to avoid tail regressions when rolling heavy kernels. Due EOD + 48h readout.
- Engineering: add model preflight checks for kernel memory deltas before rollout (action).
- CS (Lauren/Marissa): customer readout + exec note to Helios by EOD.
- Sales (Neha): credit language and renewal impact analysis.

Thanks to the team for quick coordination. We'll share the post-mortem and timeline with Helios execs later today.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Customer & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
